in_hebrew.name: Sig
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Sig הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word 'sigis' meaning 'victory'. The name Sig can also be derived from the Old Norse 'sig' meaning 'victory' or 'success'. In Norse mythology, Sig is the name of several gods and heroes associated with victory and success.
